sections.title: 课文导入

paragraph.p: zài nián qīng rén dāng zhōng

paragraph.d: v:to be directed at; to be aimed at

paragraph.p: zhōng guó wǎng hóng zhǔ bō

sections.translation: In recent years, along with the development of technology, internet celebrities have become more and more common, and social media influencers have become increasingly popular, especially among young people. In Chinese class, Teacher Wang led a discussion about internet celebrities and influencers and asked students to give a report on the topic “Chinese internet influencers.” After comparing several influencers, Liu Yue decided to introduce Li Ziqi. The following is Liu Yue’s report.

vocabulary.en: to be directed at; to be aimed at

sections.title: 介绍李子柒

paragraph.p: wǒ lái gěi dà jiā jiè shào
zhōng guó wǎng hóng zhǔ bō
zhōng guó wǎng hóng zhǔ bō

sections.translation: Hello, classmates. Today I would like to introduce Chinese internet influencer Li Ziqi. She has tens of thousands of fans on YouTube and is my favorite Chinese internet influencer.

sections.title: 她的生活与视频
sections.pinyin: tā de shēng huó yǔ shì pín

paragraph.p: tā gēn nǎi nai shēng huó zài

paragraph.c: 还会做很多好吃的中国菜
paragraph.p: hái huì zuò hěn duō hǎo chī de zhōng guó cài

paragraph.c: 穿着漂亮的中国传统服装
paragraph.p: chuān zhe piào liang de zhōng guó chuán tǒng fú zhuāng
zěn yàng zuò gè zhǒng měi shí
ràng quán shì jiè de rén
liǎo jiě zhōng guó chuán tǒng de

sections.translation: Li Ziqi is a young and filial young woman who lives with her grandmother in a beautiful mountain village in Sichuan Province. She is hardworking, kind, and capable. She can climb trees, ride horses, make swings, and cook many delicious Chinese dishes. In her videos, she always wears beautiful traditional Chinese clothing and shows how to make all kinds of food. Her videos give people around the world a chance to learn about traditional Chinese rural life.

sections.title: 场景与文化

paragraph.p: zhōng guó chuán tǒng wén huà de

sections.translation: The scenes in Li Ziqi’s videos are not tall buildings in the city, but beautiful rural countryside. Through her videos, people discover the beauty of traditional Chinese culture.

branches.label: 场景是什么？
items: 不是城市里的高楼大厦

sections.title: 我的感受

paragraph.p: zhōng guó chuán tǒng wén huà de

sections.translation: The rural life that Li Ziqi shows in her videos moved me. I think this way of life is both simple and unique. It helped me see the charm of traditional Chinese culture and made me love Chinese culture more and more.
